delta_visual=AR(candidate)-AR(V1); it may be positive when V1 is not AR rank1. Eligibility is delta_visual >= -m, selection maximizes delta_visual + beta*delta_context and changes only if strictly >tau. Exact ties preserve KEEP, otherwise frozen candidate order.

visual_only maximizes AR delta with strict positive gain; visual_margin_gate_only maximizes positive context delta among candidates inside margin, without adding visual delta. No GT in either selector.

128 user-declared combinations, eight gate-only controls, one visual-only control and KEEP. Best TRAIN tie-break: higher exact, fewer damaged, fewer changed crops, smaller m, smaller beta, larger tau. Interesting means recovered>=5, damaged<=2, net>0; no automatic pipeline promotion.

Qwen mean-token likelihood and PARSeq summed AR likelihood have different length/scale biases; beta is not a calibrated posterior. Prior cache lacks a complete cryptographic model-runtime contract.
